title: Odan hâlâ aynı

characters.MOM: a mother in her late fifties with short silver hair, wearing a terracotta cardigan
characters.MAN: a young man of about twenty-six with short black hair, wearing a navy blue jacket

scenes.text:
Evden gittiğin gün,
annen odanı neden hiç toplamadı?
scenes.prompt: An empty teenager's bedroom in afternoon light: an unmade bed, a guitar leaning against the wall, a desk by the window, autumn trees outside. No people.

scenes.text:
Yatağın aynı, perden aynı,
masan hâlâ cam kenarında.
scenes.prompt: {MOM} stands in the doorway of the empty bedroom with one hand on the door frame, looking inside with a soft smile, warm sunset light.

scenes.text:
Herkes "Misafir odası yap" dedi;
o hep "Sonra" dedi.
scenes.prompt: In the evening, {MOM} sits on the edge of the bed in the empty room, smoothing the quilt with her hand, warm lamp light, rain on the window.

scenes.text:
Çünkü o bir oda değil,
senin dönme ihtimalin.
scenes.prompt: At night, a small house seen from outside with one warm lamp glowing in an upstairs window, light rain falling, autumn leaves on the ground.

scenes.text:
Bu hafta sonu git, o odada uyu.
Bunu annene gönder.
scenes.prompt: On a sunny morning, {MAN} sleeps peacefully in the old bed under a quilt, while {MOM} stands in the doorway on the right smiling, golden light through the window.

caption:
Odan hâlâ duruyor mu?

O oda seni bekliyor. 🤍

Bunu annene gönder.
